2608.05375.title: DoctorAgents: an agentic framework to iteratively refine AutoML pipeline for small clinical temporal data
2608.05375.paper_summary: Clinical machine learning (ML) has the potential to support high-stakes medical decision-making, but reliable deployment is often constrained by scarce, heterogeneous, and temporal complexity. Developing effective ML pipelines for such data remains time-consuming and error-prone, while existing automated machine learning (AutoML) systems only partially address this challenge because they largely rely on brute-force search over predefined spaces and lack explicit reasoning and memory. We therefore reformulate AutoML for small clinical data from exhaustive search to reasoning-driven refinement. We propose DoctorAgents, an agentic AI framework that autonomously constructs and optimizes end-to-end ML pipelines through specialized large language model (LLM) agents for generation, validation, and refinement. DoctorAgents backpropagates natural-language feedback through textual gradient descent to perform targeted updates without exhaustive search. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that DoctorAgents consistently outperforms established AutoML baselines while producing more interpretable task-specific representations.
2608.05375.paper_summary_zh: 臨床機器學習（ML）有潛力支持高風險的醫療決策，但可靠的部署往往受到稀缺、異質和時間複雜性的限制。為這類數據開發有效的ML流程仍然耗時且容易出錯，而現有的自動化機器學習（AutoML）系統僅部分解決了這一挑戰，因為它們主要依賴於對預定義空間的暴力搜索，並缺乏明確的推理和記憶。因此，我們將AutoML從耗盡搜索重新構思為以推理為驅動的精煉。我們提出了DoctorAgents，一個自主構建和優化端到端ML流程的代理AI框架，通過專門的大型語言模型（LLM）代理進行生成、驗證和精煉。DoctorAgents通過文本梯度下降反向傳播自然語言反饋，以進行針對性的更新，而不需要耗盡搜索。在各種臨床任務中的實驗表明，DoctorAgents始終超越既有的AutoML基準，同時產生更具可解釋性的任務特定表示。
